data.one_liner: Fully customized dataview widget with on-demand cell building and bidirectional scroll bars.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance data table designed for Web and Desktop applications. Supports both a model mode where the table handles sorting and a builder mode for external state management.
use_when: You need to display a large amount of tabular data on Web or Desktop.
You require custom cells, pinned columns, and bidirectional scrolling.
You want either internal model-based sorting or integration with external state management like Bloc.
avoid_when: You need cell merging (rowSpan/columnSpan), which has been removed.
Your primary target is mobile touch interfaces rather than Web/Desktop.
strengths: High performance with large datasets due to building cells on demand.
Supports both model mode and builder mode for server-side or external sorting.
Highly customizable with resizable columns and dynamic row heights.
weaknesses: Cell merging is no longer supported.
Focused primarily on Web and Desktop applications.
